QUOTE: Its thread function is gated on `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD`, which are both off by default, so it does not build under the defaults either.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library creates no threads of its own and the pthread example doesn't build by default. It never says the example compiles to a stub main, and it never says a default build creates no threads at all. It also says the example programs spawn threads.
